source_name: OpenStreetMap contributors, via osmdata.openstreetmap.de pre-built land-polygons-split-4326

processing.aoi_note: A single rectangular bounding box covering Italy, Greece, Cyprus, and Turkey's coastlines inevitably also covers neighboring countries (Albania, Croatia, Slovenia, Bosnia, Montenegro, Malta, Bulgaria, and parts of the wider Balkans/Levant) at the same data quality — incidental, not a scope decision.
processing.note_on_sliver_filter: A 1-hectare minimum area (20x more aggressive than bodrum_kos_real's 500 m^2) was needed to keep this much wider region's file size manageable — this drops small islets/rocks under roughly 100m across everywhere in this region EXCEPT where a higher-detail region (bodrum-kos-real) is checked first and wins for that specific area.

sanity_checks_passed: Bodrum peninsula classifies as land (consistent with bodrum-kos-real)
Kos interior classifies as land (consistent with bodrum-kos-real)
Istanbul (near the Bosphorus) classifies as land
Mid-Aegean open sea classifies as water
Ionian sea (between Italy and Greece) classifies as water

known_limitations: Sliver filter (1 hectare minimum) drops small islets/rocks below roughly 100m across across most of this region — real navigational hazards at that scale are NOT represented outside the higher-detail bodrum-kos-real area.
No bathymetry, restriction zones, or marina/fuel-dock data.

Projection distortion: this region spans ~12 degrees of latitude (34.5-46.5N) but uses one fixed LocalProjection reference point (lat_ref=40, lon_ref=24) for the whole box. The projection's east-west (longitude) scale factor is cos(lat_ref); using one fixed reference latitude across that span means distance/fuel calculations for an origin far from the reference point (e.g. Sicily, or Turkey's Black Sea coast) can be off by roughly 10-15% in the east-west direction relative to a calculation done with the correct local latitude. This is a known, documented approximation (CLAUDE.md Section 44.20 forbids claiming navigation-grade accuracy) — a proper fix is a per-request dynamic local projection centered on the actual origin, a separate architecture change not yet made (apps/api/app/regions.py currently assigns one fixed LocalProjection per region).
data_note: Real OpenStreetMap coastline (full detail down to 1-hectare islets) covering Italy, Greece, Cyprus, Turkey, and incidentally their neighbors. No bathymetry, restrictions, or POI data. Distance/fuel accuracy degrades for origins far from this region's projection reference point. Confidence stays LOW.
